system.description: You are in possession of four arms that terminate in claw-like hands. While your extra pair of hands are able to manipulate some items, they lack the fine manual dexterity of your primary arms. You may choose to gain an extra free object interaction or use the Use an Object action twice as a single action on your turn. These extra limbs may also be used to perform the seen components of a spell provided that they are not in use in some other fashion. Your secondary arms do not grant you additional attacks and cannot wield a shield.
